SELECT /* isry.pubms.casemng.sheltrreg.mapper.DgnssReptMapper.selectLinkRcptCount */ COUNT(1) FROM SEB400 A , SCA100 A1 , SAA000 A3 , SEA200 A4 , SAA000 A5 , SEB420 B , ACA210 C , ACA400 D WHERE A.CLINT_NO = A1.ENFSN_NO(+) AND A.RCPT_INST_NO = A3.INST_NO AND A.RQST_TRPR_INFO_NO = A4.TRPR_INFO_NO AND A.RQST_INST_NO = A5.INST_NO AND A.RQST_YMD BETWEEN #{PRNMNT_USE_BGNG_YMD} AND #{PRNMNT_USE_END_YMD} AND A.SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO = B.SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO AND B.RCPT_SN = (CASE WHEN B.RCPT_SE_CD = '40' THEN (SELECT MAX(RCPT_SN) FROM SEB420 WHERE SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO = B.SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO AND RCPT_UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD}) ELSE ((SELECT MAX(RCPT_SN) FROM SEB420 WHERE SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO = B.SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO) )END) AND B.RCPT_TRPR_INFO_NO = C.TRPR_INFO_NO(+) AND B.RCPT_TRPR_INFO_NO = D.TRPR_INFO_NO(+)
AND A5.INST_NM LIKE '%' || #{RQST_INST_NM} || '%'
AND A3.INST_NM LIKE '%' || #{RCPT_INST_NM} || '%'

SELECT DECODE(A.LINK_TYPE_SE_CD, '08', A.RELA_INST_NM, C.INST_NM) AS RELA_INST_NM, /* 유관기관명(센터명) */ LPAD(A.RELA_INST_TYPE_NO, 2, '0') AS RELA_INST_TYPE_NO, /* 유관기관유형번호 */ C##RG.DEC_B64(A.CNSLTNT_NM_ENCPT) AS CNSLTNT_NM, /* 상담사명암호화 */ C##RG.DEC_B64(A.CNSLTNT_TELNO_ENCPT) AS CNSLTNT_TELNO, /* 상담사전화번호암호화 */ A.INSP_YMD AS INSP_YMD, /* 검사일자 */
CASE WHEN A.STDNT_AGE_NM||A.GRADE_SE_CD > '103' THEN 'old' ELSE 'young' END AS PTCPTN_TRGT_SE_CD, /* 참여대상구분코드 */
A.ME_INSP_YN || A.PRTCR_INSP_YN AS SRVY_YN, /* 참여희망설문 */ A.PRVC_PVSN_AGRE_YN || A.PRVC_AGRE_PRTCR_YN AS PVSN_AGRE_TRGT, /* 동의주체 */ A.PRVC_PVSN_AGRE_YN AS PRVC_PVSN_AGRE_YN, /* 개인정보제공동의여부 */
C##RG.DEC_B64(A.STDNT_NM_ENCPT) AS STDNT_NM, /* 청소년명암호화 */ A.BRTH_YMD_NM AS BRTH_YMD_NM, /* 청소년출생일자 */ A.SXDC_SE_CD AS SXDC_SE_CD, /* 성별구분코드 */
A.STDNT_AGE_NM AS STDNT_AGE_NM, /* 학생연령명 */ A.GRADE_SE_CD AS GRADE_SE_CD, /* 학년구분코드 */ A.CHIL_SCHULW_STTS_NM AS CHIL_SCHULW_STTS_NM, /* 아동학업상태명 */
C##RG.DEC_B64(A.STDNT_TELNO_ENCPT) AS STDNT_TELNO, /* 청소년전화번호암호화 */ C##RG.DEC_B64(A.PRTCR_FLNM_ENCPT) AS PRTCR_FLNM, /* 보호자명암호화 */ C##RG.DEC_B64(A.PRTCR_TELNO_ENCPT) AS PRTCR_TELNO, /* 보호자전화번호암호화 */ A.TRPR_ADDR AS TRPR_ADDR, /* 대상자주소 */ A.CTPV_NM AS CTPV_NM, /* 시도명 */
A.RESULT_CHRCTR_SNDNG_NO AS RESULT_CHRCTR_SNDNG_NO, /* 결과문자발송번호 */
A.MEDIAA_ACTN_MTHD_CN AS MEDIAA_ACTN_MTHD_CN, /* 미디어조치방법내용 */
A.ACTN_CN AS ACTN_CN, /* 조치내용 */ A.INTRVN_STTS_SE_CD AS INTRVN_STTS_SE_CD, /* 개입상태구분코드 */ A.ACTN_YMD AS ACTN_YMD, /* 조치일자 */ A.ADDTNG_TRL_INSP_YN AS ADDTNG_TRL_INSP_YN, /* 추가심리요청여부 */ A.UNITVN_CS_SE_CD AS UNITVN_CS_SE_CD, /* 미개입사유구분코드 */
A.TRPR_INFO_NO AS TRPR_INFO_NO, /* 대상자정보번호 */ A.ETC_CN AS ETC_CN, /* 기타내용 */ B.CASE_MNG_SE_CD AS CASE_MNG_SE_CD, /* 사례관리구분코드 */
A.DGNSS_EXMN_MNG_NO AS DGNSS_EXMN_MNG_NO /* 진단조사관리번호 */
FROM ACA400 A, SEA200 B, SAA000 C WHERE A.TRPR_INFO_NO = B.TRPR_INFO_NO AND A.CNTER_ALTMNT_INST_NO = C.INST_NO(+) AND A.TRPR_INFO_NO = #{TRPR_INFO_NO}

/* selectDgnssScoreTrmnList - Lee MS */
WITH AA AS ( SELECT A.DGNSS_EXMN_MNG_NO AS DGNSS_EXMN_MNG_NO, A.DGNSS_EXMN_SE_CD AS DGNSS_EXMN_SE_CD, /* 진단조사구분코드 */ SUM(DECODE(A.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_TYPE_SE_CD||A.SCORE_SE_SE_CD, '01001', DGNSS_SCORE)) AS DGNSS_SCORE101, SUM(DECODE(A.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_TYPE_SE_CD||A.SCORE_SE_SE_CD, '01002', DGNSS_SCORE)) AS DGNSS_SCORE102, SUM(DECODE(A.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_TYPE_SE_CD||A.SCORE_SE_SE_CD, '01003', DGNSS_SCORE)) AS DGNSS_SCORE103, SUM(DECODE(A.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_TYPE_SE_CD||A.SCORE_SE_SE_CD, '01004', DGNSS_SCORE)) AS DGNSS_SCORE104, SUM(DECODE(A.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_TYPE_SE_CD||A.SCORE_SE_SE_CD, '01005', DGNSS_SCORE)) AS DGNSS_SCORE105, SUM(DECODE(A.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_TYPE_SE_CD||A.SCORE_SE_SE_CD, '01006', DGNSS_SCORE)) AS DGNSS_SCORE106, SUM(DECODE(A.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_TYPE_SE_CD||A.SCORE_SE_SE_CD, '01007', DGNSS_SCORE)) AS DGNSS_SCORE107, SUM(DECODE(A.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_TYPE_SE_CD||A.SCORE_SE_SE_CD, '01008', DGNSS_SCORE)) AS DGNSS_SCORE108, SUM(DECODE(A.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_TYPE_SE_CD||A.SCORE_SE_SE_CD, '01009', DGNSS_SCORE)) AS DGNSS_SCORE109, SUM(DECODE(A.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_TYPE_SE_CD||A.SCORE_SE_SE_CD, '01010', DGNSS_SCORE)) AS DGNSS_SCORE110, SUM(DECODE(A.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_TYPE_SE_CD||A.SCORE_SE_SE_CD, '01011', DGNSS_SCORE)) AS DGNSS_SCORE111, SUM(DECODE(A.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_TYPE_SE_CD||A.SCORE_SE_SE_CD, '01012', DGNSS_SCORE)) AS DGNSS_SCORE112, SUM(DECODE(A.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_TYPE_SE_CD||A.SCORE_SE_SE_CD, '01013', DGNSS_SCORE)) AS DGNSS_SCORE113, SUM(DECODE(A.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_TYPE_SE_CD||A.SCORE_SE_SE_CD, '01014', DGNSS_SCORE)) AS DGNSS_SCORE114, SUM(DECODE(A.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_TYPE_SE_CD||A.SCORE_SE_SE_CD, '01015', DGNSS_SCORE)) AS DGNSS_SCORE115, SUM(DECODE(A.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_TYPE_SE_CD, '01', DGNSS_SCORE)) AS DGNSS_SCORETOT01,
SUM(DECODE(A.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_TYPE_SE_CD||A.SCORE_SE_SE_CD, '02001', DGNSS_SCORE)) AS DGNSS_SCORE01, SUM(DECODE(A.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_TYPE_SE_CD||A.SCORE_SE_SE_CD, '02002', DGNSS_SCORE)) AS DGNSS_SCORE02, SUM(DECODE(A.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_TYPE_SE_CD||A.SCORE_SE_SE_CD, '02003', DGNSS_SCORE)) AS DGNSS_SCORE03, SUM(DECODE(A.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_TYPE_SE_CD||A.SCORE_SE_SE_CD, '02004', DGNSS_SCORE)) AS DGNSS_SCORE04, SUM(DECODE(A.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_TYPE_SE_CD||A.SCORE_SE_SE_CD, '02005', DGNSS_SCORE)) AS DGNSS_SCORE05, SUM(DECODE(A.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_TYPE_SE_CD||A.SCORE_SE_SE_CD, '02006', DGNSS_SCORE)) AS DGNSS_SCORE06, SUM(DECODE(A.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_TYPE_SE_CD||A.SCORE_SE_SE_CD, '02007', DGNSS_SCORE)) AS DGNSS_SCORE07, SUM(DECODE(A.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_TYPE_SE_CD||A.SCORE_SE_SE_CD, '02008', DGNSS_SCORE)) AS DGNSS_SCORE08, SUM(DECODE(A.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_TYPE_SE_CD||A.SCORE_SE_SE_CD, '02009', DGNSS_SCORE)) AS DGNSS_SCORE09, SUM(DECODE(A.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_TYPE_SE_CD||A.SCORE_SE_SE_CD, '02010', DGNSS_SCORE)) AS DGNSS_SCORE10, SUM(DECODE(A.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_TYPE_SE_CD||A.SCORE_SE_SE_CD, '02011', DGNSS_SCORE)) AS DGNSS_SCORE11, SUM(DECODE(A.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_TYPE_SE_CD||A.SCORE_SE_SE_CD, '02012', DGNSS_SCORE)) AS DGNSS_SCORE12, SUM(DECODE(A.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_TYPE_SE_CD||A.SCORE_SE_SE_CD, '02013', DGNSS_SCORE)) AS DGNSS_SCORE13, SUM(DECODE(A.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_TYPE_SE_CD||A.SCORE_SE_SE_CD, '02014', DGNSS_SCORE)) AS DGNSS_SCORE14, SUM(DECODE(A.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_TYPE_SE_CD||A.SCORE_SE_SE_CD, '02015', DGNSS_SCORE)) AS DGNSS_SCORE15, SUM(DECODE(A.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_TYPE_SE_CD, '02', DGNSS_SCORE)) AS DGNSS_SCORETOT FROM ACA410 A /* 진단조사구분코드 - 인터넷자가, 스마트폰자가, 인터넷관찰, 스마트폰관찰 */ WHERE A.DGNSS_EXMN_MNG_NO = #{DGNSS_EXMN_MNG_NO} AND A.DGNSS_EXMN_SE_CD IN ('1', '2', '3', '4') AND A.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_TYPE_SE_CD IN ('01', '02') GROUP BY A.DGNSS_EXMN_MNG_NO, A.DGNSS_EXMN_SE_CD ), AAA AS ( SELECT AA.*, BB.MEDIAA_SCHL_SE_CD AS STDNT_AGE_NM, /*학년구분 */ CASE WHEN AA.DGNSS_EXMN_SE_CD IN ('1', '3') THEN DGNSS_SCORE101 + DGNSS_SCORE105 + DGNSS_SCORE109 + DGNSS_SCORE112 + DGNSS_SCORE115 ELSE DGNSS_SCORE101 + DGNSS_SCORE105 + DGNSS_SCORE109 + DGNSS_SCORE112 + DGNSS_SCORE113 END AS DGNSS_SCOREB1, CASE WHEN AA.DGNSS_EXMN_SE_CD IN ('1', '3') THEN DGNSS_SCORE103 + DGNSS_SCORE107 + DGNSS_SCORE110 + DGNSS_SCORE113 ELSE DGNSS_SCORE103 + DGNSS_SCORE107 + DGNSS_SCORE110 + DGNSS_SCORE114 END AS DGNSS_SCOREB2, CASE WHEN AA.DGNSS_EXMN_SE_CD IN ('1', '3') THEN DGNSS_SCORE104 + DGNSS_SCORE108 + DGNSS_SCORE111 + DGNSS_SCORE114 ELSE DGNSS_SCORE104 + DGNSS_SCORE108 + DGNSS_SCORE111 + DGNSS_SCORE115 END AS DGNSS_SCOREB3, DGNSS_SCORE102 + DGNSS_SCORE106 AS DGNSS_SCOREB4,
CASE WHEN AA.DGNSS_EXMN_SE_CD IN ('1', '3') THEN DGNSS_SCORE01 + DGNSS_SCORE05 + DGNSS_SCORE09 + DGNSS_SCORE12 + DGNSS_SCORE15 ELSE DGNSS_SCORE01 + DGNSS_SCORE05 + DGNSS_SCORE09 + DGNSS_SCORE12 + DGNSS_SCORE13 END AS DGNSS_SCOREA1, CASE WHEN AA.DGNSS_EXMN_SE_CD IN ('1', '3') THEN DGNSS_SCORE03 + DGNSS_SCORE07 + DGNSS_SCORE10 + DGNSS_SCORE13 ELSE DGNSS_SCORE03 + DGNSS_SCORE07 + DGNSS_SCORE10 + DGNSS_SCORE14 END AS DGNSS_SCOREA2, CASE WHEN AA.DGNSS_EXMN_SE_CD IN ('1', '3') THEN DGNSS_SCORE04 + DGNSS_SCORE08 + DGNSS_SCORE11 + DGNSS_SCORE14 ELSE DGNSS_SCORE04 + DGNSS_SCORE08 + DGNSS_SCORE11 + DGNSS_SCORE15 END AS DGNSS_SCOREA3, DGNSS_SCORE02 + DGNSS_SCORE06 AS DGNSS_SCOREA4
FROM AA, ACA200 BB WHERE AA.DGNSS_EXMN_MNG_NO = BB.DGNSS_EXMN_MNG_NO )
SELECT AAA.*, CASE WHEN AAA.DGNSS_EXMN_SE_CD IN ('1') THEN /* 인터넷진단 */ CASE WHEN AAA.STDNT_AGE_NM = '1' THEN /* 초등학교 */ CASE WHEN AAA.DGNSS_SCORETOT01 >= 42 THEN '1' WHEN AAA.DGNSS_SCOREB1 >= 14 AND AAA.DGNSS_SCOREB2 >= 13 AND AAA.DGNSS_SCOREB3 >= 13 THEN '1' WHEN AAA.DGNSS_SCORETOT01 < 42 AND AAA.DGNSS_SCORETOT01 >= 39 THEN '2' WHEN AAA.DGNSS_SCOREB1 >= 13 OR AAA.DGNSS_SCOREB2 >= 12 OR AAA.DGNSS_SCOREB3 >= 11 THEN '2' ELSE '3' END ELSE /* 중고등학교*/ CASE WHEN AAA.DGNSS_SCORETOT01 >= 44 THEN '1' WHEN AAA.DGNSS_SCOREB1 >= 15 AND AAA.DGNSS_SCOREB2 >= 13 AND AAA.DGNSS_SCOREB3 >=14 THEN '1' WHEN AAA.DGNSS_SCORETOT01 < 44 AND AAA.DGNSS_SCORETOT01 >= 41 THEN '2' WHEN AAA.DGNSS_SCOREB1 >= 14 OR AAA.DGNSS_SCOREB2 >= 12 OR AAA.DGNSS_SCOREB3 >= 12 THEN '2' ELSE '3' END END WHEN AAA.DGNSS_EXMN_SE_CD IN ('3') THEN /* 인터넷진단 -관찰자진단*/ CASE WHEN AAA.STDNT_AGE_NM = '1' THEN /* 초등학교 */ CASE WHEN AAA.DGNSS_SCORETOT01 >= 30 THEN '1' WHEN AAA.DGNSS_SCOREB1 >= 14 AND AAA.DGNSS_SCOREB2 >= 12 AND AAA.DGNSS_SCOREB3 >= 11 THEN '1' WHEN AAA.DGNSS_SCORETOT01 < 30 AND AAA.DGNSS_SCORETOT01 >= 28 THEN '2' WHEN AAA.DGNSS_SCOREB1 >= 13 OR AAA.DGNSS_SCOREB2 >= 11 OR AAA.DGNSS_SCOREB3 >= 10 THEN '2' ELSE '3' END ELSE /* 중고등학교*/ CASE WHEN AAA.DGNSS_SCORETOT01 >= 35 THEN '1' WHEN AAA.DGNSS_SCOREB1 >= 14 AND AAA.DGNSS_SCOREB2 >= 12 AND AAA.DGNSS_SCOREA3 >= 11 THEN '1' WHEN AAA.DGNSS_SCORETOT01 < 35 AND AAA.DGNSS_SCORETOT01 >= 32 THEN '2' WHEN AAA.DGNSS_SCOREB1 >= 13 OR AAA.DGNSS_SCOREB2 >= 11 OR AAA.DGNSS_SCOREA3 >= 10 THEN '2' ELSE '3' END END ELSE /* 스마트폰진단 */ CASE WHEN AAA.DGNSS_SCORETOT01 >= 45 THEN '1' WHEN AAA.DGNSS_SCOREB1 >= 16 AND AAA.DGNSS_SCOREB2 >= 13 AND AAA.DGNSS_SCOREB3 >=14 THEN '1' WHEN AAA.DGNSS_SCORETOT01 < 45 AND AAA.DGNSS_SCORETOT01 >= 42 THEN '2' WHEN AAA.DGNSS_SCOREB1 >= 14 OR AAA.DGNSS_SCOREB2 >= 12 OR AAA.DGNSS_SCOREB3 >= 13 THEN '2' ELSE '3' END END AS DGNSS_SCOREBR,
CASE WHEN AAA.DGNSS_SCORETOT IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CASE WHEN AAA.DGNSS_EXMN_SE_CD IN ('1') THEN /* 인터넷진단 */ CASE WHEN AAA.STDNT_AGE_NM = '1' THEN /* 초등학교 */ CASE WHEN AAA.DGNSS_SCORETOT >= 42 THEN '1' WHEN AAA.DGNSS_SCOREA1 >= 14 AND AAA.DGNSS_SCOREA2 >= 13 AND AAA.DGNSS_SCOREA3 >= 13 THEN '1' WHEN AAA.DGNSS_SCORETOT < 42 AND AAA.DGNSS_SCORETOT >= 39 THEN '2' WHEN AAA.DGNSS_SCOREA1 >= 13 OR AAA.DGNSS_SCOREA2 >= 12 OR AAA.DGNSS_SCOREA3 >= 11 THEN '2' ELSE '3' END ELSE /* 중고등학교*/ CASE WHEN AAA.DGNSS_SCORETOT >= 44 THEN '1' WHEN AAA.DGNSS_SCOREA1 >= 15 AND AAA.DGNSS_SCOREA2 >= 13 AND AAA.DGNSS_SCOREA3 >=14 THEN '1' WHEN AAA.DGNSS_SCORETOT < 44 AND AAA.DGNSS_SCORETOT >= 41 THEN '2' WHEN AAA.DGNSS_SCOREA1 >= 14 OR AAA.DGNSS_SCOREA2 >= 12 OR AAA.DGNSS_SCOREA3 >= 12 THEN '2' ELSE '3' END END WHEN AAA.DGNSS_EXMN_SE_CD IN ('3') THEN /* 인터넷진단 -관찰자진단*/ CASE WHEN AAA.STDNT_AGE_NM = '1' THEN /* 초등학교 */ CASE WHEN AAA.DGNSS_SCORETOT >= 30 THEN '1' WHEN AAA.DGNSS_SCOREA1 >= 14 AND AAA.DGNSS_SCOREA2 >= 12 AND AAA.DGNSS_SCOREA3 >= 11 THEN '1' WHEN AAA.DGNSS_SCORETOT < 30 AND AAA.DGNSS_SCORETOT >= 28 THEN '2' WHEN AAA.DGNSS_SCOREA1 >= 13 OR AAA.DGNSS_SCOREA2 >= 11 OR AAA.DGNSS_SCOREA3 >= 10 THEN '2' ELSE '3' END ELSE /* 중고등학교*/ CASE WHEN AAA.DGNSS_SCORETOT >= 35 THEN '1' WHEN AAA.DGNSS_SCOREA1 >= 14 AND AAA.DGNSS_SCOREA2 >= 12 AND AAA.DGNSS_SCOREA3 >= 11 THEN '1' WHEN AAA.DGNSS_SCORETOT < 35 AND AAA.DGNSS_SCORETOT >= 32 THEN '2' WHEN AAA.DGNSS_SCOREA1 >= 13 OR AAA.DGNSS_SCOREA2 >= 11 OR AAA.DGNSS_SCOREA3 >= 10 THEN '2' ELSE '3' END END ELSE /* 스마트폰진단 */ CASE WHEN AAA.DGNSS_SCORETOT >= 45 THEN '1' WHEN AAA.DGNSS_SCOREA1 >= 16 AND AAA.DGNSS_SCOREA2 >= 13 AND AAA.DGNSS_SCOREA3 >=14 THEN '1' WHEN AAA.DGNSS_SCORETOT < 45 AND AAA.DGNSS_SCORETOT >= 42 THEN '2' WHEN AAA.DGNSS_SCOREA1 >= 14 OR AAA.DGNSS_SCOREA2 >= 12 OR AAA.DGNSS_SCOREA3 >= 13 THEN '2' ELSE '3' END END END AS DGNSS_SCOREAR FROM AAA ORDER BY DGNSS_EXMN_SE_CD
